title: Date of birth and phone digits given in parts, then the floor
script: Confirms she is Priya Nair. When asked for the date of birth, says only 'the seventeenth of May' and stops; gives the year 'nineteen eighty-six' in the next turn or when asked. When asked for the phone digits, says 'fifteen' and stops; says 'oh two' in the next turn or when asked. Then says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the minimum payment for this Friday.
forbidden: asking how much she can pay
checks: the agent asks only for the missing part of an answer and never asks for the whole answer 'in one go'
the agent never asks how much she can pay
minimum payment offered once, with the note that the rest stays overdue
promise for 637.50 on Friday 16 October

title: Asks why the date of birth is needed, corrects the phone digits, pays today
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. When asked for the date of birth, first asks 'why do you need that?'; after the reply gives 14 March 1988. When asked for the phone digits says 'four four seven... sorry, four four seven one' in one sentence. Says he can pay the full amount today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: the agent explains that the questions protect the account and does not close the call
both security questions passed before get_account
the word 'collections' is not said before identity is verified
text-message sentence said after the promise

title: Date of birth as numbers with the month first, then the month as a word
script: Confirms he is Samuel Ortiz. When first asked for the date of birth, says it only as numbers with the month first: 'twelve, five, nineteen seventy-five'. If asked to say the month as a word, says 'December, the fifth, nineteen seventy-five'. Gives the phone digits 7093 when asked. Cannot pay today. Says 'the week after next'. When asked for the exact day, says Monday the 26th. Accepts the next business day when it is offered.
forbidden: a wrong answer counted for the swapped date
checks: after the bank's hint the agent asks for the month as a word and does not treat it as a wrong answer
agent asks once for the exact day
the agent does not accept 26 October and offers the next business day
promise recorded for Tuesday 27 October

title: Lost his job, but names his own amount and day (experiments/variations/hardship-own-offer.json)
script: Verified. When asked about paying, says in ONE message that he lost his job last month but could pay 300 on Friday. Does not want to be transferred to the support team. If the agent reads back 300 on Friday 16 October, confirms it.
checks: one sentence of sympathy
support team offered once
no persuasion attempt and no offer of a different amount or day
the customer's own amount and day are recorded: 300 on Friday 16 October
no discount, waiver or plan offered

title: Partial yes at the read-back, then a changed amount for one product
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Wants to pay both on 30 October. Accepts when told the loan has an earlier latest date. At the first read-back says only 'yes for the credit card'. When asked again, says she wants to pay only 300 on the personal loan, on the same day. At the next read-back, if it says credit card 300 on 30 October and personal loan 300 on 23 October, confirms both.
forbidden: create_promise before the whole package is confirmed
checks: no promise is recorded after the partial yes
the changed amount is read back again before anything is recorded
loan recorded on its own deadline, 23 October
one create_promise per product

title: One promise, one dispute, one already paid
script: Gives the date of birth and the phone digits correctly. Cannot pay everything today. Will pay the credit card in full tomorrow. Says the personal loan is not his, he never had one. Says he already paid the car loan in the app this morning. Confirms the read-back of the credit card.

checks: the agent does not argue about the personal loan
the agent says payments can take one business day to appear
exactly one promise, on the credit card
a dispute note for the personal loan and a paid note for the car loan
